<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 540 450" width="540" height="450">
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Grid lines -->
  <!-- Horizontal grid lines for velocity: -7 to 11, marked every 5 (-5, 0, 5, 10). Let's also include -5, 0, 5, 10 precisely -->
  <!-- We map v from -7 to 11. Height of plot area = 300px. -->
  <!-- y = 0 maps to velocity = 0. Let v=0 be at y=200. -->
  <!-- Scale: 1 m/s = 300 / 18 ≈ 16.67 px. Let's make 1 unit = 15 px. -->
  <!-- Let's check dimensions carefully. -->

  <!-- 
       Origin of graph: (100, 240)
       x-axis: time / s from 0 to 2.8. Let 1 s = 120 px. 2.8 s = 336 px.
       y-axis: velocity / m/s from -7 to 11. 
       Let velocity 0 be at y = 220.
       Scale for v: 1 m/s = 15 px.
       v = 11 -> y = 220 - (11 * 15) = 220 - 165 = 55.
       v = 10 -> y = 220 - (10 * 15) = 70.
       v = 5  -> y = 220 - (5 * 15) = 145.
       v = 0  -> y = 220.
       v = -5 -> y = 220 - (-5 * 15) = 295.
       v = -7 -> y = 220 - (-7 * 15) = 325.

       Let's check time scale:
       t = 0 -> x = 100
       t = 0.5 -> x = 100 + 0.5 * 120 = 160
       t = 1.0 -> x = 100 + 1.0 * 120 = 220
       t = 1.5 -> x = 100 + 1.5 * 120 = 280
       t = 2.0 -> x = 100 + 2.0 * 120 = 340
       t = 2.5 -> x = 100 + 2.5 * 120 = 400
       t = 2.8 -> x = 100 + 2.8 * 120 = 436
  -->

  <!-- Horizontal Grid Lines -->
  <line x1="100" y1="55" x2="450" y2="55" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="130" x2="450" y2="130" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- v = 6 -->
  <line x1="100" y1="145" x2="450" y2="145" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- v = 5 -->
  <line x1="100" y1="220" x2="450" y2="220" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/> <!-- v = 0 (t-axis) -->
  <line x1="100" y1="295" x2="450" y2="295" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- v = -5 -->
  <line x1="100" y1="325" x2="450" y2="325" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- v = -7 -->

  <!-- Vertical Grid Lines (every 0.5 s) -->
  <line x1="100" y1="40" x2="100" y2="350" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/> <!-- t = 0 (v-axis) -->
  <line x1="160" y1="40" x2="160" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- t = 0.5 -->
  <line x1="220" y1="40" x2="220" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- t = 1.0 -->
  <line x1="280" y1="40" x2="280" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- t = 1.5 -->
  <line x1="340" y1="40" x2="340" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- t = 2.0 -->
  <line x1="400" y1="40" x2="400" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- t = 2.5 -->
  <line x1="436" y1="40" x2="436" y2="350" stroke="#e0e0e0" stroke-width="1"/> <!-- t = 2.8 -->

  <!-- Axis ticks and labels -->
  <!-- Vertical axis labels (-7, -5, 0, 5, 10) -->
  <font-family font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif">
    <!-- v = 10 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="70" x2="100" y2="70" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="85" y="74" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">10</text>

    <!-- v = 5 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="145" x2="100" y2="145" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="85" y="149" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">5</text>

    <!-- v = 0 -->
    <text x="85" y="224" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">0</text>

    <!-- v = -5 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="295" x2="100" y2="295" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="85" y="299" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">−5</text>

    <!-- v = -7 -->
    <line x1="95" y1="325" x2="100" y2="325" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="85" y="329" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">−7</text>

    <!-- Horizontal axis ticks and labels (0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5) -->
    <!-- t = 0 -->
    <text x="100" y="240" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">0</text>

    <!-- t = 0.5 -->
    <line x1="160" y1="220" x2="160" y2="225" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="160" y="240" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">0.5</text>

    <!-- t = 1.0 -->
    <line x1="220" y1="220" x2="220" y2="225" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="220" y="240" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">1.0</text>

    <!-- t = 1.5 -->
    <line x1="280" y1="220" x2="280" y2="225" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="280" y="240" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">1.5</text>

    <!-- t = 2.0 -->
    <line x1="340" y1="220" x2="340" y2="225" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="340" y="240" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">2.0</text>

    <!-- t = 2.5 -->
    <line x1="400" y1="220" x2="400" y2="225" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="400" y="240" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">2.5</text>

    <!-- Axis Titles -->
    <text x="465" y="216" font-size="14" font-style="italic">time</text>
    <text x="496" y="216" font-size="14">/ s</text>

    <text x="95" y="32" font-size="14" font-style="italic" text-anchor="end">velocity</text>
    <text x="95" y="48" font-size="14" text-anchor="end">/ m s</text>
    <text x="122" y="44" font-size="10">−1</text>
  </font-family>

  <!-- Graphs / Data Lines -->
  <!-- 
       Point (0,0) -> x=100, y=220
       Point X (1.0, 10) -> x=220, y=70
       Dashed vertical drop from X to Y? Wait, "A dashed line from X down to Y at (1.2, -6)."
       Let's check X: (1.0, 10) -> x=220, y=70
       Let's check Y: (1.2, -6) -> x = 100 + 1.2*120 = 244. y = 220 - (-6*15) = 220 + 90 = 310.
       Wait, "A dashed line from X down to Y at (1.2, -6)." Usually means X is at t=1.0, v=10, and the transition/contact starts or is indicated, or is it a vertical dashed line?
       Let's re-read carefully: "A straight line from (0, 0) up to X at (1.0, 10). A dashed line from X down to Y at (1.2, -6)."
       Ah, standard physics graph for trampoline: free fall until X (t=1.0, v=10), then contact with trampoline from X to Y? Or does the graph go straight from X to Y with a dashed line? Or is X at (1.0, 10) and Y at (1.2, -6) connected by a dashed line?
       "A straight line from (0, 0) up to X at (1.0, 10). A dashed line from X down to Y at (1.2, -6). A straight line from Y up to Z at (1.8, 0)."
       Let's draw:
       1. Solid line from (0,0) to X(1.0, 10). -> x=100,y=220 to x=220,y=70.
       2. Dashed line from X(1.0, 10) to Y(1.2, -6). -> x=220,y=70 to x=244,y=310.
       3. Solid line from Y(1.2, -6) to Z(1.8, 0). -> x=244,y=310 to x = 100 + 1.8*120 = 316, y = 220.
  -->

  <!-- Line 1: (0,0) to X(1.0, 10) -->
  <line x1="100" y1="220" x2="220" y2="70" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Line 2: Dashed from X(1.0, 10) to Y(1.2, -6) -->
  <line x1="220" y1="70" x2="244" y2="310" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5,4"/>

  <!-- Line 3: Solid from Y(1.2, -6) to Z(1.8, 0) -->
  <line x1="244" y1="310" x2="316" y2="220" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Points and Labels X, Y, Z -->
  <font-family font-family="Times New Roman, Times, serif" font-style="italic">
    <text x="230" y="68" font-size="16">X</text>
    <text x="252" y="322" font-size="16">Y</text>
    <text x="325" y="215" font-size="16">Z</text>
  </font-family>

  <!-- Small dots for X, Y, Z to be clear -->
  <circle cx="220" cy="70" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="244" cy="310" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="316" cy="220" r="3" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Dashed guide lines to axes if needed? The prompt doesn't strictly require, but let's keep it clean as requested -->

  <!-- Caption -->
  <font-family font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
    <text x="270" y="395" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 1.1</text>
  </font-family>

</svg>
